issues.claim: Amboy Insurance Agent — category 'Insurance agency', website https://amboyinsuranceagent.com/, address Unknown
issues.problem: The listed website now resolves to a State Farm captive agent page (Juan Nava – State Farm, 963 US Highway 9 Suite 12, South Amboy). That is a brand-franchised agency — an excluded type under the mapper's own stated rules — and 'Amboy Insurance Agent' is not the business's name.
issues.fix: Delete the entry. Keep CNJ Insurance Agency as the only insurance lead and re-check any further agency for carrier branding before listing.

issues.claim: Carter & Sons Roofing — 456 Smith St, South Amboy, (848) 222-2090
issues.problem: The company's own location/contact page places this office at 456 Smith St, Perth Amboy NJ 08861 — a different municipality and ZIP than the list states. Verified wrong town.
issues.fix: Remove from this zone, or re-file under Perth Amboy with the corrected town and ZIP.

issues.claim: Pride Landscape Supply — 350 Ernston Rd, South Amboy
issues.problem: The company's own locations page lists 350 Ernston Rd, Parlin NJ 08859 (Sayreville). The mapper's note suspected this but the town field was still 'South Amboy', so it would enter the zone as an eligible business when it isn't one.
issues.fix: Remove from this zone or re-file under Parlin/Sayreville.

issues.claim: Venetian Care & Rehabilitation Center — website http://www.windsorhealthcare.org/venetian
issues.problem: That URL returns HTTP 404. The campus's live site is venetianrehab.com (275 John T. O'Leary Blvd, 732-721-8200) and it now presents itself as Venetian Post Acute, so both the URL and the brand name are stale.
issues.fix: Replace with https://venetianrehab.com/, update the name/branding, and confirm the current operator before outreach.

issues.claim: South Amboy Car Wash (Go Go Car Wash) — 2087 Route 35, (732) 952-2642
issues.problem: A different business currently markets itself at 2087 Route 35 as South Amboy Hand Car Wash & Detailing Center, and 'Go Go Car Wash' is a multi-site car-wash brand. The mapper left the independence test unresolved, so this is either stale or an excluded chain site.
issues.fix: Confirm the current operator and trading name in person or by phone; drop the entry if it is a Go Go Car Wash location.

issues.claim: South Amboy Roofing & Roof Repair (117 S Stevens Ave) and South Amboy Roofing Services (334 2nd St)
issues.problem: Both are generic 'South Amboy Roofing' name matches from Google Maps with zero reviews; a search at 117 S Stevens Ave surfaces a different contractor (JC Contracting) instead. Neither could be confirmed as a real local business — they look like lead-generation listings.
issues.fix: Drop both, or hold them in an 'unverified' bucket until a phone check or NJ contractor registration confirms them.

issues.claim: South Amboy NJ Locksmith — 'mobile' locksmith on southamboynjlocksmith.com
issues.problem: The site gives a 'dispatch address' of 330 Bordentown Ave, Ste 105 — the same address the list uses for Haircut Store — with no named owner or staff and templated copy. Consistent with a national lead-generation network site rather than a local operator.
issues.fix: Treat as a lead-gen listing and exclude unless a local, named operator is confirmed.

issues.claim: Chain/network branches kept: South Amboy YMCA, Acelero Learning South Amboy, Venetian Care (Windsor Health), Horizon Termite Control, Go Go Car Wash
issues.problem: All are branches of multi-site organizations, while brand-franchised insurance and dental franchises were dropped. The same exclusion rule is applied two different ways in one list.
issues.fix: State one rule. Either drop network/branch entities consistently, or document that nonprofit or single-campus branches are in scope and why, and apply that to the insurance and dental cases too.

issues.claim: School-adjacent entries: Jesse Selover Preschool (Leading Edge) at 150 Lincoln St and Acelero Learning at 310 Augusta St
issues.problem: Both are licensed childcare/Head Start programs run by outside multi-district or multi-state operators; the Leading Edge program is a contracted before/after-care program at a district school building. These sit close to the brief's 'schools' exclusion and are not comparable to the independent private childcare centre also listed.
issues.fix: Either exclude contracted in-school programs, or record the reasoning in the entry so the outreach team isn't surprised.

issues.problem: Only two dentists are listed (Madura/DDS, Tanchyk/DMD). Three further South Amboy practices were easy to confirm and are missing: Studio Smiles (441 Gordon St), Bayshore Dental Excellence (1872 Route 35), Jeffrey A. Gee DDS (329 S Pine Ave). Roughly 25% of the dentist category found is covered.
issues.fix: Add the three practices; the dental category is the weakest in the list.
